text: Maakan ɓe -an Nulaaɗo-: Anndu ko mi yamiraa ko yo mi Rewu Jooma saare Makka nden On harminɗo nde, ƴiiƴam rufetaake e nder mayre, hay gooto tooñetaake e mayre, mbaroodi mayre waretaake, leɗɗe mayre soppetaake, no woodani Mo O Senike kala huunde, mi yamiraama kadi yo mi wonu jeyaaɗo e ɓen jebbilaniiɓe Alla ɗoftori Mo Dewal.
